verdict.rationale: Zero's official MCP server documentation lists 'Bulk delete emails' and 'Bulk archive emails' as tools. That directly gives an AI agent bulk operations across many emails at once, alongside single-item actions like marking read/unread and modifying labels. missing for 10: bulk support beyond delete/archive (e.g. bulk labeling or mark-read), detail on how items are selected or what the batch limits are, and independent or hands-on confirmation that bulk actions work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Bulk delete emails - Bulk archive emails
